description: Figure 2 illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different approaches labeled “ours,” “critiquing,” “scoring,” and “ranking.” The horizontal axis represents these four approaches, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “NDCG@10” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.25, with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. Four vertical bars are present, one for each approach. The “critiquing” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 0.18. The “ours” bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 0.23. The “ranking” bar is gray and extends to approximately 0.12. Finally, the “scoring” bar is orange and reaches approximately 0.20. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged in alphabetical order based on their labels.
